name: Base Lending
rootCause: Base Lending was exploited on Base on 25 October 2024, resulting in a loss of approximately $1 million after the attacker manipulated a WETH price oracle in unverified lending contracts. The exploit was enabled by a lending contract using a single-source price oracle with limited liquidity for WETH. This setup allowed the attacker to manipulate the WETH price, inflate collateral value, and drain funds via excessive borrowing.
